scope: Post-freeze local diagnostic security checks on validation used for selection. Supplied models/attack teachers were exposed to these validation IDs; not an independent held-out performance estimate.

sampling.sampling_method: Stratified simple random sample: 20 per class, then restore original CSV order
sampling.selected_ids_sha256_encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON array of ID strings, ensure_ascii=False

clean_timing.scope: Two warm-up batches excluded; includes loader iteration, normalization to [0,1], host/device copies and prediction; excludes initial image decode and metric/file writing

attacks.name: cw_l2
attacks.attack_target: complete deployed predictor, untargeted, true-label margin
attacks.score_representation: raw logits for original model; normalized log probabilities serve as logits of the final averaged distribution for TTA/ensemble
attacks.budget_filter_interpretation: Out-of-budget standard-L2 outputs use the clean prediction for this secondary count; search failure or invalidity is not evidence of robustness
attacks.timing_scope: Warm-up excluded; input transfers, C&W input optimization, float/8bit predictor inference included; setup, metrics and payload/CSV writing excluded
attacks.quantization_scope: Post-hoc rounding of the minimum-L2 successful float candidate only; no quantization-aware search
